notes.title: Fixed Patch
notes.notes:
・A checkpoint has been set up at the first stage of the action stage.
・Correction of the collider not attaching correctly.
・Changed the number of continues from 20 to 30.
・Some minor fixes.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: LOOPER★LOOPER!!
notes.notes:
Today, we have released LOOPER★LOOPER! 
Clickers, actions, battles—each of them serves a purpose.
LOOPER★LOOPER is a clicker game with a compelling storyline. 
We plan to continue updating it in the future, so we would be delighted if you find it interesting.
